question: Which continent-wide scheme lets grid companies cancel out each other's opposite shortfalls and surpluses instead of ranking price offers?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 22(2) of Regulation 2017/2195 describes the European platform for the imbalance netting process as consisting of the imbalance netting process function and the TSO-TSO settlement function on a multilateral TSO-TSO model. verdict.gold_reason: Article 22(2) of Regulation 2017/2195 describes the European platform for the imbalance netting process as consisting of the imbalance netting process function and the TSO-TSO settlement function on a multilateral TSO-TSO model. Articles 19(2), 20(2) and 21(2) show that the other platforms use an activation optimisation function and common merit order lists, so the contrast in the reference answer is supported.

other_articles.why: Describes the imbalance netting process (reducing counteracting FRR activations) but does not describe a continent-wide platform.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question's wording is vague ("scheme", "continent-wide"), but the imbalance netting platform is the only reasonable match. Article 146 of Regulation 2017/1485 covers the process at LFC-area level, not the platform.
